sources.licence: Local reference only. No photograph, crop or photo texture is distributed.
sources.accuracy: GPS horizontal errors 3.0–12.9 m; headings are not calibrated camera poses. Dimensions below are visual estimates.

sources.use: Existing registered facilities, tower, footways and road/water geometry; no new map imagery was accessed.

registration: world/geographic-frame.json. Existing street and water surfaces retained; photo GPS is evidence, not a replacement placement.

gate.name: Saigo longhouse gate
gate.note: Registered footprint retained. Closed paired doors, strap hinges, studded posts, side wicket and projecting barred windows are photo-derived; rear is a closed modest timber/plaster exterior.

benchPads.basis: Photo 0881 gravel seat openings, estimated dimensions on the retained level verge. The same polygons supply rendered finish and Ground support.

buildings.registrationConfidence: Medium: closest long north-facing shop footprint along the photographed heading; the 12.9 m GPS error prevents survey-level identification. Frontage and roof-room dimensions are estimates; no business name or hidden interior is asserted.

guide.placementBasis: Photographed on the town side, looking across the junction to the low moat map. GPS fixes straddle the street (6.2–7.2 m uncertainty); placed on the existing town-side corner behind the mapped walking line. Not surveyed.
guide.distances: Photo-date text, not live directions or simulated traffic rules.

tactile.note: Follows the retained bent footway then the mapped footway. No invented warning pad at an unverified crossing; edge detail does not change Ground height.

trees.placementBasis: Root fitted to the retained landward bank; branches lean over water.
Root on the mapped moat-side verge east of the ownership join; photo position is the photographer, not the trunk.
Tree behind the sloping map, on the mapped bank; photo-relative estimate.

limitations: The retained south shore differs from OSM. Bench source points remain in field-observations.json; explicit placements fit the curved retained bank. The separate gravel waterside path in 0881 is compressed into the existing narrow verge, not claimed as a surveyed reconstruction.
The 0871 parade closure is temporary and is not made permanent. 0879 confirms restriction text but not a reliably registered pole; no invented restriction pole or traffic-rule change.

0890/0891 view an office beyond the eastern walkable boundary and are not used to invent an extension. 0892 has a medium-confidence footprint match based on proximity, the southward camera heading and long north frontage; it is explicitly estimated, not a surveyed identification.
Map artwork and historical photographs on the boards are not copied. In-scene maps are original schematics of existing OSM geometry; small unreadable text and hidden interiors are not fabricated.
